purpose: Separate offline stop/target/horizon learning target, not existing policy PnL or fixed-horizon gross labels
rules: Explicit data scope, fixed horizon, fee/spread/slippage and existing stop/target bounds bind target hash
Full contiguous closed horizon must be available at asOf, even if a barrier occurred early
Model entry at candle open; entry-bar path timing is an idealization, not nominal+5s execution
Open gaps precede intrabar extremes; adverse stops use open, favorable targets conservatively use target
Both barriers touched with open between them yields ambiguous and null payoff, never stop-first or target-first label
No barrier yields costed horizon-close outcome, not a winning/losing barrier class
No fitting, probability, strategy deployment, threshold sweep or July outcomes
